verdict.rationale: Whether a product's source is available under an open license is a fair question for a feature-flag and experimentation platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions open-source repositories, source availability, or any license (MIT, Apache, etc.) for Statsig's platform or SDKs. The CLI, MCP server, APIs and OpenAPI spec are other capabilities and do not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
